name: Paragon Finance Limited
about: Paragon Finance Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in loans against hypothecation of vehicles in India. The company also invests in equity market and mutual funds In addition, it is involved in the real estate development business; and trading in derivatives, as well as construction and planning. The company was formerly known as Paragon Finance and Plywood Industries Ltd and changed its name to Paragon Finance Limited in August 1993. Paragon Finance Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Kolkata, India.
